card.name: Spell Scribing
card.effect: Spell Scribing. Tags: base, passive, spellbook. Copying a legal found Wizard spell into your spellbook requires 1 hour and 25 gp of inks and components per spell rank, treating rank 0 as rank 1 for this calculation, instead of the pilot baseline 2 hours and 50 gp. Level-up spells remain free.

source.originalText: Spell Scribing: Copy spells into your spellbook at half the normal cost and time.

card.name: Arcane Insight
card.effect: Arcane Insight. Tags: base, passive, knowledge. Gain proficiency in Arcana, or expertise if already proficient. When examining an active magical effect, spell residue, magic item or arcane construction, you may make an Intelligence (Arcana) check to determine its broad school, function or unusual matrix behavior. The Director sets the normal knowledge DC; failure supplies no invented fact.

source.originalText: Arcane Insight: Identify magical effects and items with greater accuracy than non-wizards.

card.name: Matrix Efficiency
card.effect: Matrix Efficiency. Tags: base, passive, matrix. Your normal full daily Spell Matrix preparation time is reduced from 1 hour to 45 minutes. This does not reduce the separate 10-minute midday substitution ritual, spell scribing, rituals or spellbook reconstruction unless another feature explicitly says so.

source.originalText: Matrix Efficiency: Reduce the preparation time for spells by 25%.

card.name: Scholarly Mind
card.effect: Scholarly Mind. Tags: base, passive, knowledge. You have advantage on Intelligence checks whose primary purpose is recalling, researching or analyzing arcane theory, magical history, planar magical principles or constructed spell formulae. It does not grant advantage on spell attacks, Counterspell checks or general Investigation unrelated to arcane scholarship.

source.originalText: Scholarly Mind: Gain advantage on Intelligence checks related to arcane knowledge.

card.name: Arcane Bolt
card.effect: Arcane Bolt. Tags: base, active, wizard-spell, universal, damage. Make a Wizard spell attack. On a hit deal S d6 + M force damage. Arcane Bolt is an always-prepared class matrix once acquired and uses the normal first-distinct-matrix and Refrain rules.

source.originalText: Arcane Bolt: Launch a bolt of pure arcane energy that deals force damage to a single target.

card.name: Minor Conjuration
card.frequency: At will while RP remains; one object at a time
card.effect: Minor Conjuration. Tags: base, active, wizard-spell, conjuration. Create one nonmagical unattended object that fits inside a 1-foot cube, weighs no more than 10 pounds and is made of common nonvaluable material such as wood, cloth, clay, iron or glass. It cannot be food, poison, currency, a spell component with listed cost, ammunition with special properties or a functional complex mechanism. Creating another dismisses the first.

source.originalText: Minor Conjuration: Create a temporary, small inanimate object that lasts for 1 hour.

card.name: Arcane Shield
card.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
card.effect: Arcane Shield. Tags: base, active, wizard-spell, abjuration, protection. Trigger when an attack roll would hit you. Gain +2 AC against the triggering attack and until the start of your next regular turn, potentially causing the attack to miss. Temporary AC from another Arcane Shield does not stack.

source.originalText: Arcane Shield: Create a barrier of magical force that provides temporary protection.

card.name: Analyze Magic
card.rangeAndTarget: One magical creature, object or effect within 30 feet
card.effect: Analyze Magic. Tags: base, active, wizard-spell, divination, knowledge. Make an Intelligence (Arcana) check against DC 10 + the effect's spell rank, treating a non-spell effect's Director-assigned tier as rank. On success learn its school or magical category, one active mechanical property and whether it is currently sustained, cursed or bound to another effect. Failure reveals only that magic is present.

source.originalText: Analyze Magic: Study a magical effect or item to gain insight into its properties and function.

card.name: Spellbook Study
card.effect: Spellbook Study. Tags: base, active, matrix, ritual. Replace one currently prepared matrix with one legal spell recorded in your spellbook. The replacement must be within your Wizard rank limit. This is the normal midday substitution permission; it does not alter the spellbook, create another prepared-matrix position or reset first-cast/Refrain history for an underlying matrix family already cast this encounter.

source.originalText: Spellbook Study: Spend time studying your spellbook to prepare a different selection of spells.

card.name: Floating Preparation
card.effect: Floating Preparation. Tags: arch, passive, matrix. Increase your maximum prepared Spell Matrix count by 1. The extra matrix can come from any school and obeys all ordinary spellbook and rank restrictions. It is a prepared matrix for every rule, including protected strain, duplicate-family tracking and Matrix Mastery modifications.

source.originalText: Floating Preparation: Prepare 1 extra spell from any school each day

card.name: Sigil Rewrite
card.effect: Sigil Rewrite. Tags: arch, passive-upgrade, matrix. Replace one prepared matrix with a different spell from your spellbook of exactly the same rank without performing the normal 10-minute ritual. The replacement receives no special Dissonance reset for a matrix family already used this encounter and must obey current Wizard rank eligibility.

source.originalText: Sigil Rewrite: Once/day, instantly swap a spell you know for another of the same tier

card.name: Spell Tether
card.effect: Spell Tether. Tags: arch, passive-upgrade, concentration, tether. When you begin a second concentration spell that targets only yourself while already concentrating on a self-only spell, spend 3 additional RP. For up to 3 rounds you may maintain both. Whenever damage requires a concentration save, make one save; failure ends BOTH spells. Starting a third concentration effect ends both tethered spells before the new one begins. Spell Tether and Tethered Cast cannot be combined; maximum two sustained concentration effects total. Only one Spell Tether can exist at a time.

source.originalText: Spell Tether: Maintain 2 self-buff spells without concentration (1/rest)

card.name: Matrix Mastery
card.effect: Matrix Mastery. Tags: arch, passive, matrix. During preparation you may assign at most one common Matrix Mastery modification to each ordinary prepared spell: Quick Substitution, Component Enhancement, Matrix Linking or Stability Reinforcement, using the exact common definitions in the Wizard engine. Always-prepared class-card matrices cannot receive these modifications unless a card explicitly says otherwise.

source.originalText: Matrix Mastery: Modify spell matrices to change minor aspects of prepared spells.

card.name: Arcane Tradition
card.frequency: Automatic at Wizard 3; not a selection
card.effect: Arcane Tradition. Tags: arch, school, automatic. Your level-1 Arcane School becomes your Arcanist tradition; do not choose a second school. Prepare one additional matrix from that same school each day without counting it against your normal prepared-matrix maximum. It otherwise obeys all ordinary rank, spellbook, Dissonance and duplicate-family rules.

source.originalText: Arcane Tradition: Choose a school of magic to specialize in, gaining bonuses to spells of that school.

card.name: Improved Concentration
card.effect: Improved Concentration. Tags: arch, passive, concentration. You have advantage on Constitution saving throws made because damage threatens your concentration on a Wizard spell. This does not alter the DC, protect a Tether from rules that explicitly end both effects, or prevent Silence, incapacitation and other non-damage concentration failures.

source.originalText: Improved Concentration: Advantage on concentration checks when taking damage.

card.name: Counterspell
card.rangeAndTarget: One creature you perceive casting a spell within 60 feet
card.effect: Counterspell. Tags: arch-source, automatic, wizard-spell, abjuration, disruption. Trigger when a creature begins casting a spell. Make an Intelligence check adding proficiency against DC 10 + twice the spell's rank, treating rank 0 as 0. Success negates the triggering spell after its costs are paid; failure lets it resolve. This is gained automatically at Wizard 2 and is never also selected from the Arch pool.

source.originalText: Counterspell: Disrupt an enemy's spellcasting, potentially negating their spell entirely.

card.name: Arcane Lock
card.rangeAndTarget: One door, chest, portal or unattended object within touch
card.effect: Arcane Lock. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, abjuration. Magically seal the target. Opening it without your permission requires a Strength check or thieves'/arcane-tool check against your Wizard spell DC. Dispel Magic can end the lock. You can designate up to M creatures who can bypass it. This does not make the object physically indestructible.

source.originalText: Arcane Lock: Create a magical barrier that prevents entry or access to an object or area.

card.name: Dispel Magic
card.rangeAndTarget: One creature, object or magical effect within 60 feet
card.effect: Dispel Magic. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, abjuration. Choose one ongoing spell effect you can perceive. If its rank is 3 or lower, end it. If it is rank 4 or higher, make an Intelligence check adding proficiency against DC 10 + spell rank; success ends it. Permanent artifact properties and effects explicitly immune to dispelling are unaffected.

source.originalText: Dispel Magic: End magical effects in an area or on a target.

card.name: Dimensional Pocket
card.effect: Dimensional Pocket. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, conjuration, ritual. Create an extradimensional storage space holding up to 100 pounds or 10 cubic feet of unattended nonliving material. Retrieving or placing an item while adjacent to the opening uses an object interaction. Living creatures cannot enter. When duration ends, remaining contents appear harmlessly in the nearest unoccupied space.

source.originalText: Dimensional Pocket: Create a small extradimensional space to store items.

card.name: Arcane Sight
card.effect: Arcane Sight. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, divination, concentration. While active you perceive magical auras within 60 feet and automatically know each visible aura's school or broad magical category. As an Action on a later turn, examine one aura to learn whether it is concentrated, summoned, cursed, warded or linked to another visible magical effect. Total cover blocks sight.

source.originalText: Arcane Sight: See magical auras and effects for a short duration.

card.name: Spell Preservation
card.effect: Spell Preservation. Tags: hero, spellbinder, passive, spellbook. Your primary spellbook cannot be destroyed, erased or rendered permanently unreadable by non-artifact mundane or magical means. It can still be stolen, hidden, transported, suppressed, sealed by an artifact-level effect or voluntarily abandoned. Copies and backup books do not automatically receive this protection.

source.originalText: Spell Preservation: Your spellbook cannot be destroyed by non-artifact means.

card.name: Knowledge Shield
card.rangeAndTarget: Allies directly protected by one of your Abjuration Wizard spells
card.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
card.frequency: At most once per ally per round
card.effect: Knowledge Shield. Tags: hero, spellbinder, passive, protection. When you cast an Abjuration spell that grants AC, temporary HP, resistance or a saving-throw benefit to an ally, that ally also gains +2 on its next saving throw before the start of your next regular turn. Multiple Knowledge Shields do not stack.

source.originalText: Knowledge Shield: When you cast a protective spell, allies gain +2 to saving throws.

card.name: Matrix Sharing
card.cost: 2 RP plus the shared spell's normal RP cost
card.duration: Until end of ally's next regular turn
card.effect: Matrix Sharing. Tags: hero, spellbinder, passive-upgrade, matrix. Choose one prepared Wizard spell of rank 3 or lower with an Action casting time. Pay both costs now. The ally may cast that spell once before the end of its next turn without paying RP, using your spell attack and DC. The shared spell cannot summon creatures, create additional Actions, use Overcast, be Shared again or bypass concentration limits. Granting this permission takes your Action; the ally spends its own normal Action to cast. The ally owns concentration and strain for the cast, and it does not update your matrix-family history or grant you cast-trigger resources.

source.originalText: Matrix Sharing: Grant an ally temporary access to one of your prepared spells.

card.name: Arcane Memory
card.cost: Normal RP cost of recalled spell
card.effect: Arcane Memory. Tags: hero, spellbinder, passive-upgrade, spellbook. Cast one legal-rank Wizard spell that you previously prepared and have recorded in your campaign memory log, even if it is not currently prepared or its spellbook entry is unavailable. Pay the normal RP cost and obey casting time, concentration and all ordinary restrictions. This grants no spell above your Wizard rank limit.

source.originalText: Arcane Memory: Recall and cast any spell you've ever prepared once per long rest.

card.name: Seal Magic
card.effect: Seal Magic. Tags: hero, spellbinder, wizard-spell, control. Choose one of the eight schools and target one creature. It makes a Wisdom save. On failure it cannot cast spells of the chosen school. At the end of each of its turns it repeats the save, ending the Seal on success. The effect ends automatically after 3 rounds and never prevents non-spell class techniques merely because they are magical.

source.originalText: Seal Magic: Prevent a target from casting spells of a specific school (WIS save, 3 rounds)

card.name: Ritual Casting
card.cost: 0 RP unless the individual ritual explicitly states otherwise
card.frequency: At will outside encounters with sufficient time
card.effect: Source progression line 5184. Cast a Wizard spell bearing the Ritual tag directly from your spellbook without preparing it. Increase its casting time by at least 10 minutes. Ritual Casting cannot be completed during an encounter, does not use an ordinary prepared-matrix position and does not generate or vent normal casting Dissonance.

source.originalText: | 2 | Counterspell Reaction, Ritual Casting |

card.name: School Mastery
card.effect: Source progression line 5186. This is the one School Mastery progression grant, not a second school choice or duplicate feat. Increase the level-1 Arcane School spell-attack and spell-save bonus from +1 to +2 total. Its school passive and bonus-spell rules otherwise remain unchanged.

source.originalText: | 5 | Bonus Feat: School Mastery |

card.name: Arcane Ward
card.effect: Source progression line 5187. After preparing spells, choose one of acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, necrotic, psychic, radiant or thunder that is dealt by at least one prepared spell of your Arcane School. Gain resistance to that damage type until your next long rest. If none of your prepared school spells deals a damage type, choose force. This is provisional completion of the source's ambiguous 'chosen school's element' wording.

source.originalText: | 6 | Arcane Ward (resistance to chosen school's element) |

card.name: Dual Cast
card.cost: Pay the complete RP costs of both spells
card.effect: Source progression line 5188. Choose two DIFFERENT prepared Wizard spells of rank 1 or 2, neither of which summons a creature or grants an additional Action. Cast both sequentially as one Action, paying both RP costs. They cannot both require concentration. Each matrix separately updates first-cast/Refrain history. Features that trigger merely from 'casting a spell' may trigger once for each actual matrix unless that feature itself says once per turn; no trigger may create another Dual Cast or additional full Action.

source.originalText: | 9 | Dual Cast (cast 2 Tier 1–2 spells in a round) |

card.name: Overchannel
card.cost: Pay the Core V 2 RP cost for one rank above the spell's normal cast rank
card.rangeAndTarget: One prepared spell you are beginning to cast
card.effect: Source progression line 5190. Cast one prepared spell as though it were one rank higher than the highest rank at which you could normally cast that SAME spell, provided the spell has an explicit higher-rank scaling rule. Overchannel does not teach or prepare a higher-rank spell, cannot exceed effective rank 9 and cannot be combined with another generic Overcast rule during this pilot. All normal Dissonance/Refrain rules still apply.

source.originalText: | 13 | Overchannel (cast a spell 1 tier higher once/day) |

card.name: Arcane Feedback
card.effect: Source progression line 5191, converted from historical slot wording to RP. After your Counterspell successfully negates a spell, restore 1 RP, never above your normal maximum. A counter produced by a companion, reflected spell or copied Counterspell does not trigger this feature.

source.originalText: | 15 | Arcane Feedback (after successfully countering a spell, recover 1 RP once per round) |

card.name: Tethered Cast
card.rangeAndTarget: One concentration Wizard spell you cast this turn that targets only yourself or one willing ally
card.frequency: At most once per round; only one Tethered Cast active at a time
card.effect: Source progression line 5192. After casting the qualifying spell, tether it. The tethered spell no longer occupies your one normal concentration slot for up to 3 rounds. When damage would require a concentration save for the tethered spell, make the save normally; failure ends only the tether. Starting another Tethered Cast ends the existing tether first. A Tethered Cast cannot itself tether Spell Tether's second spell or permit more than two simultaneously sustained Wizard effects.

source.originalText: | 17 | Tethered Cast (bonus action spell link 1/round) |

card.name: Spell Scribing
card.effect: Spell Scribing. Tags: base, passive, spellbook. Copying a legal found Wizard spell into your spellbook requires 1 hour and 25 gp of inks and components per spell rank, treating rank 0 as rank 1 for this calculation, instead of the pilot baseline 2 hours and 50 gp. Level-up spells remain free.

source.originalText: Spell Scribing: Copy spells into your spellbook at half the normal cost and time.

card.name: Arcane Insight
card.effect: Arcane Insight. Tags: base, passive, knowledge. Gain proficiency in Arcana, or expertise if already proficient. When examining an active magical effect, spell residue, magic item or arcane construction, you may make an Intelligence (Arcana) check to determine its broad school, function or unusual matrix behavior. The Director sets the normal knowledge DC; failure supplies no invented fact.

source.originalText: Arcane Insight: Identify magical effects and items with greater accuracy than non-wizards.

card.name: Matrix Efficiency
card.effect: Matrix Efficiency. Tags: base, passive, matrix. Your normal full daily Spell Matrix preparation time is reduced from 1 hour to 45 minutes. This does not reduce the separate 10-minute midday substitution ritual, spell scribing, rituals or spellbook reconstruction unless another feature explicitly says so.

source.originalText: Matrix Efficiency: Reduce the preparation time for spells by 25%.

card.name: Scholarly Mind
card.effect: Scholarly Mind. Tags: base, passive, knowledge. You have advantage on Intelligence checks whose primary purpose is recalling, researching or analyzing arcane theory, magical history, planar magical principles or constructed spell formulae. It does not grant advantage on spell attacks, Counterspell checks or general Investigation unrelated to arcane scholarship.

source.originalText: Scholarly Mind: Gain advantage on Intelligence checks related to arcane knowledge.

card.name: Arcane Bolt
card.effect: Arcane Bolt. Tags: base, active, wizard-spell, universal, damage. Make a Wizard spell attack. On a hit deal S d6 + M force damage. Arcane Bolt is an always-prepared class matrix once acquired and uses the normal first-distinct-matrix and Refrain rules.

source.originalText: Arcane Bolt: Launch a bolt of pure arcane energy that deals force damage to a single target.

card.name: Minor Conjuration
card.frequency: At will while RP remains; one object at a time
card.effect: Minor Conjuration. Tags: base, active, wizard-spell, conjuration. Create one nonmagical unattended object that fits inside a 1-foot cube, weighs no more than 10 pounds and is made of common nonvaluable material such as wood, cloth, clay, iron or glass. It cannot be food, poison, currency, a spell component with listed cost, ammunition with special properties or a functional complex mechanism. Creating another dismisses the first.

source.originalText: Minor Conjuration: Create a temporary, small inanimate object that lasts for 1 hour.

card.name: Arcane Shield
card.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
card.effect: Arcane Shield. Tags: base, active, wizard-spell, abjuration, protection. Trigger when an attack roll would hit you. Gain +2 AC against the triggering attack and until the start of your next regular turn, potentially causing the attack to miss. Temporary AC from another Arcane Shield does not stack.

source.originalText: Arcane Shield: Create a barrier of magical force that provides temporary protection.

card.name: Analyze Magic
card.rangeAndTarget: One magical creature, object or effect within 30 feet
card.effect: Analyze Magic. Tags: base, active, wizard-spell, divination, knowledge. Make an Intelligence (Arcana) check against DC 10 + the effect's spell rank, treating a non-spell effect's Director-assigned tier as rank. On success learn its school or magical category, one active mechanical property and whether it is currently sustained, cursed or bound to another effect. Failure reveals only that magic is present.

source.originalText: Analyze Magic: Study a magical effect or item to gain insight into its properties and function.

card.name: Spellbook Study
card.effect: Spellbook Study. Tags: base, active, matrix, ritual. Replace one currently prepared matrix with one legal spell recorded in your spellbook. The replacement must be within your Wizard rank limit. This is the normal midday substitution permission; it does not alter the spellbook, create another prepared-matrix position or reset first-cast/Refrain history for an underlying matrix family already cast this encounter.

source.originalText: Spellbook Study: Spend time studying your spellbook to prepare a different selection of spells.

card.name: Floating Preparation
card.effect: Floating Preparation. Tags: arch, passive, matrix. Increase your maximum prepared Spell Matrix count by 1. The extra matrix can come from any school and obeys all ordinary spellbook and rank restrictions. It is a prepared matrix for every rule, including protected strain, duplicate-family tracking and Matrix Mastery modifications.

source.originalText: Floating Preparation: Prepare 1 extra spell from any school each day

card.name: Sigil Rewrite
card.effect: Sigil Rewrite. Tags: arch, passive-upgrade, matrix. Replace one prepared matrix with a different spell from your spellbook of exactly the same rank without performing the normal 10-minute ritual. The replacement receives no special Dissonance reset for a matrix family already used this encounter and must obey current Wizard rank eligibility.

source.originalText: Sigil Rewrite: Once/day, instantly swap a spell you know for another of the same tier

card.name: Spell Tether
card.effect: Spell Tether. Tags: arch, passive-upgrade, concentration, tether. When you begin a second concentration spell that targets only yourself while already concentrating on a self-only spell, spend 3 additional RP. For up to 3 rounds you may maintain both. Whenever damage requires a concentration save, make one save; failure ends BOTH spells. Starting a third concentration effect ends both tethered spells before the new one begins. Spell Tether and Tethered Cast cannot be combined; maximum two sustained concentration effects total. Only one Spell Tether can exist at a time.

source.originalText: Spell Tether: Maintain 2 self-buff spells without concentration (1/rest)

card.name: Matrix Mastery
card.effect: Matrix Mastery. Tags: arch, passive, matrix. During preparation you may assign at most one common Matrix Mastery modification to each ordinary prepared spell: Quick Substitution, Component Enhancement, Matrix Linking or Stability Reinforcement, using the exact common definitions in the Wizard engine. Always-prepared class-card matrices cannot receive these modifications unless a card explicitly says otherwise.

source.originalText: Matrix Mastery: Modify spell matrices to change minor aspects of prepared spells.

card.name: Arcane Tradition
card.frequency: Automatic at Wizard 3; not a selection
card.effect: Arcane Tradition. Tags: arch, school, automatic. Your level-1 Arcane School becomes your Arcanist tradition; do not choose a second school. Prepare one additional matrix from that same school each day without counting it against your normal prepared-matrix maximum. It otherwise obeys all ordinary rank, spellbook, Dissonance and duplicate-family rules.

source.originalText: Arcane Tradition: Choose a school of magic to specialize in, gaining bonuses to spells of that school.

card.name: Improved Concentration
card.effect: Improved Concentration. Tags: arch, passive, concentration. You have advantage on Constitution saving throws made because damage threatens your concentration on a Wizard spell. This does not alter the DC, protect a Tether from rules that explicitly end both effects, or prevent Silence, incapacitation and other non-damage concentration failures.

source.originalText: Improved Concentration: Advantage on concentration checks when taking damage.

card.name: Counterspell
card.rangeAndTarget: One creature you perceive casting a spell within 60 feet
card.effect: Counterspell. Tags: arch-source, automatic, wizard-spell, abjuration, disruption. Trigger when a creature begins casting a spell. Make an Intelligence check adding proficiency against DC 10 + twice the spell's rank, treating rank 0 as 0. Success negates the triggering spell after its costs are paid; failure lets it resolve. This is gained automatically at Wizard 2 and is never also selected from the Arch pool.

source.originalText: Counterspell: Disrupt an enemy's spellcasting, potentially negating their spell entirely.

card.name: Arcane Lock
card.rangeAndTarget: One door, chest, portal or unattended object within touch
card.effect: Arcane Lock. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, abjuration. Magically seal the target. Opening it without your permission requires a Strength check or thieves'/arcane-tool check against your Wizard spell DC. Dispel Magic can end the lock. You can designate up to M creatures who can bypass it. This does not make the object physically indestructible.

source.originalText: Arcane Lock: Create a magical barrier that prevents entry or access to an object or area.

card.name: Dispel Magic
card.rangeAndTarget: One creature, object or magical effect within 60 feet
card.effect: Dispel Magic. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, abjuration. Choose one ongoing spell effect you can perceive. If its rank is 3 or lower, end it. If it is rank 4 or higher, make an Intelligence check adding proficiency against DC 10 + spell rank; success ends it. Permanent artifact properties and effects explicitly immune to dispelling are unaffected.

source.originalText: Dispel Magic: End magical effects in an area or on a target.

card.name: Dimensional Pocket
card.effect: Dimensional Pocket. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, conjuration, ritual. Create an extradimensional storage space holding up to 100 pounds or 10 cubic feet of unattended nonliving material. Retrieving or placing an item while adjacent to the opening uses an object interaction. Living creatures cannot enter. When duration ends, remaining contents appear harmlessly in the nearest unoccupied space.

source.originalText: Dimensional Pocket: Create a small extradimensional space to store items.

card.name: Arcane Sight
card.effect: Arcane Sight. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, divination, concentration. While active you perceive magical auras within 60 feet and automatically know each visible aura's school or broad magical category. As an Action on a later turn, examine one aura to learn whether it is concentrated, summoned, cursed, warded or linked to another visible magical effect. Total cover blocks sight.

source.originalText: Arcane Sight: See magical auras and effects for a short duration.

card.name: Spell Preservation
card.effect: Spell Preservation. Tags: hero, spellbinder, passive, spellbook. Your primary spellbook cannot be destroyed, erased or rendered permanently unreadable by non-artifact mundane or magical means. It can still be stolen, hidden, transported, suppressed, sealed by an artifact-level effect or voluntarily abandoned. Copies and backup books do not automatically receive this protection.

source.originalText: Spell Preservation: Your spellbook cannot be destroyed by non-artifact means.

card.name: Knowledge Shield
card.rangeAndTarget: Allies directly protected by one of your Abjuration Wizard spells
card.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
card.frequency: At most once per ally per round
card.effect: Knowledge Shield. Tags: hero, spellbinder, passive, protection. When you cast an Abjuration spell that grants AC, temporary HP, resistance or a saving-throw benefit to an ally, that ally also gains +2 on its next saving throw before the start of your next regular turn. Multiple Knowledge Shields do not stack.

source.originalText: Knowledge Shield: When you cast a protective spell, allies gain +2 to saving throws.

card.name: Matrix Sharing
card.cost: 2 RP plus the shared spell's normal RP cost
card.duration: Until end of ally's next regular turn
card.effect: Matrix Sharing. Tags: hero, spellbinder, passive-upgrade, matrix. Choose one prepared Wizard spell of rank 3 or lower with an Action casting time. Pay both costs now. The ally may cast that spell once before the end of its next turn without paying RP, using your spell attack and DC. The shared spell cannot summon creatures, create additional Actions, use Overcast, be Shared again or bypass concentration limits. Granting this permission takes your Action; the ally spends its own normal Action to cast. The ally owns concentration and strain for the cast, and it does not update your matrix-family history or grant you cast-trigger resources.

source.originalText: Matrix Sharing: Grant an ally temporary access to one of your prepared spells.

card.name: Arcane Memory
card.cost: Normal RP cost of recalled spell
card.effect: Arcane Memory. Tags: hero, spellbinder, passive-upgrade, spellbook. Cast one legal-rank Wizard spell that you previously prepared and have recorded in your campaign memory log, even if it is not currently prepared or its spellbook entry is unavailable. Pay the normal RP cost and obey casting time, concentration and all ordinary restrictions. This grants no spell above your Wizard rank limit.

source.originalText: Arcane Memory: Recall and cast any spell you've ever prepared once per long rest.

card.name: Seal Magic
card.effect: Seal Magic. Tags: hero, spellbinder, wizard-spell, control. Choose one of the eight schools and target one creature. It makes a Wisdom save. On failure it cannot cast spells of the chosen school. At the end of each of its turns it repeats the save, ending the Seal on success. The effect ends automatically after 3 rounds and never prevents non-spell class techniques merely because they are magical.

source.originalText: Seal Magic: Prevent a target from casting spells of a specific school (WIS save, 3 rounds)

card.name: Ritual Casting
card.cost: 0 RP unless the individual ritual explicitly states otherwise
card.frequency: At will outside encounters with sufficient time
card.effect: Source progression line 5184. Cast a Wizard spell bearing the Ritual tag directly from your spellbook without preparing it. Increase its casting time by at least 10 minutes. Ritual Casting cannot be completed during an encounter, does not use an ordinary prepared-matrix position and does not generate or vent normal casting Dissonance.

source.originalText: | 2 | Counterspell Reaction, Ritual Casting |

card.name: School Mastery
card.effect: Source progression line 5186. This is the one School Mastery progression grant, not a second school choice or duplicate feat. Increase the level-1 Arcane School spell-attack and spell-save bonus from +1 to +2 total. Its school passive and bonus-spell rules otherwise remain unchanged.

source.originalText: | 5 | Bonus Feat: School Mastery |

card.name: Arcane Ward
card.effect: Source progression line 5187. After preparing spells, choose one of acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, necrotic, psychic, radiant or thunder that is dealt by at least one prepared spell of your Arcane School. Gain resistance to that damage type until your next long rest. If none of your prepared school spells deals a damage type, choose force. This is provisional completion of the source's ambiguous 'chosen school's element' wording.

source.originalText: | 6 | Arcane Ward (resistance to chosen school's element) |

card.name: Dual Cast
card.cost: Pay the complete RP costs of both spells
card.effect: Source progression line 5188. Choose two DIFFERENT prepared Wizard spells of rank 1 or 2, neither of which summons a creature or grants an additional Action. Cast both sequentially as one Action, paying both RP costs. They cannot both require concentration. Each matrix separately updates first-cast/Refrain history. Features that trigger merely from 'casting a spell' may trigger once for each actual matrix unless that feature itself says once per turn; no trigger may create another Dual Cast or additional full Action.

source.originalText: | 9 | Dual Cast (cast 2 Tier 1–2 spells in a round) |

card.name: Overchannel
card.cost: Pay the Core V 2 RP cost for one rank above the spell's normal cast rank
card.rangeAndTarget: One prepared spell you are beginning to cast
card.effect: Source progression line 5190. Cast one prepared spell as though it were one rank higher than the highest rank at which you could normally cast that SAME spell, provided the spell has an explicit higher-rank scaling rule. Overchannel does not teach or prepare a higher-rank spell, cannot exceed effective rank 9 and cannot be combined with another generic Overcast rule during this pilot. All normal Dissonance/Refrain rules still apply.

source.originalText: | 13 | Overchannel (cast a spell 1 tier higher once/day) |

card.name: Arcane Feedback
card.effect: Source progression line 5191, converted from historical slot wording to RP. After your Counterspell successfully negates a spell, restore 1 RP, never above your normal maximum. A counter produced by a companion, reflected spell or copied Counterspell does not trigger this feature.

source.originalText: | 15 | Arcane Feedback (after successfully countering a spell, recover 1 RP once per round) |

card.name: Tethered Cast
card.rangeAndTarget: One concentration Wizard spell you cast this turn that targets only yourself or one willing ally
card.frequency: At most once per round; only one Tethered Cast active at a time
card.effect: Source progression line 5192. After casting the qualifying spell, tether it. The tethered spell no longer occupies your one normal concentration slot for up to 3 rounds. When damage would require a concentration save for the tethered spell, make the save normally; failure ends only the tether. Starting another Tethered Cast ends the existing tether first. A Tethered Cast cannot itself tether Spell Tether's second spell or permit more than two simultaneously sustained Wizard effects.

source.originalText: | 17 | Tethered Cast (bonus action spell link 1/round) |

Always-prepared class-card matrices cannot receive these modifications unless a card explicitly says otherwise.

source.originalText: Matrix Mastery: Modify spell matrices to change minor aspects of prepared spells.

card.name: Arcane Tradition
card.frequency: Automatic at Wizard 3; not a selection
card.effect: Arcane Tradition. Tags: arch, school, automatic. Your level-1 Arcane School becomes your Arcanist tradition; do not choose a second school. Prepare one additional matrix from that same school each day without counting it against your normal prepared-matrix maximum. It otherwise obeys all ordinary rank, spellbook, Dissonance and duplicate-family rules.

source.originalText: Arcane Tradition: Choose a school of magic to specialize in, gaining bonuses to spells of that school.

card.name: Improved Concentration
card.effect: Improved Concentration. Tags: arch, passive, concentration. You have advantage on Constitution saving throws made because damage threatens your concentration on a Wizard spell. This does not alter the DC, protect a Tether from rules that explicitly end both effects, or prevent Silence, incapacitation and other non-damage concentration failures.

source.originalText: Improved Concentration: Advantage on concentration checks when taking damage.

card.name: Counterspell
card.rangeAndTarget: One creature you perceive casting a spell within 60 feet
card.effect: Counterspell. Tags: arch-source, automatic, wizard-spell, abjuration, disruption. Trigger when a creature begins casting a spell. Make an Intelligence check adding proficiency against DC 10 + twice the spell's rank, treating rank 0 as 0. Success negates the triggering spell after its costs are paid; failure lets it resolve. This is gained automatically at Wizard 2 and is never also selected from the Arch pool.

source.originalText: Counterspell: Disrupt an enemy's spellcasting, potentially negating their spell entirely.

card.name: Arcane Lock
card.rangeAndTarget: One door, chest, portal or unattended object within touch
card.effect: Arcane Lock. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, abjuration. Magically seal the target. Opening it without your permission requires a Strength check or thieves'/arcane-tool check against your Wizard spell DC. Dispel Magic can end the lock. You can designate up to M creatures who can bypass it. This does not make the object physically indestructible.

source.originalText: Arcane Lock: Create a magical barrier that prevents entry or access to an object or area.

card.name: Dispel Magic
card.rangeAndTarget: One creature, object or magical effect within 60 feet
card.effect: Dispel Magic. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, abjuration. Choose one ongoing spell effect you can perceive. If its rank is 3 or lower, end it. If it is rank 4 or higher, make an Intelligence check adding proficiency against DC 10 + spell rank; success ends it. Permanent artifact properties and effects explicitly immune to dispelling are unaffected.

source.originalText: Dispel Magic: End magical effects in an area or on a target.

card.name: Dimensional Pocket
card.effect: Dimensional Pocket. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, conjuration, ritual. Create an extradimensional storage space holding up to 100 pounds or 10 cubic feet of unattended nonliving material. Retrieving or placing an item while adjacent to the opening uses an object interaction. Living creatures cannot enter. When duration ends, remaining contents appear harmlessly in the nearest unoccupied space.

source.originalText: Dimensional Pocket: Create a small extradimensional space to store items.

card.name: Arcane Sight
card.effect: Arcane Sight. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, divination, concentration. While active you perceive magical auras within 60 feet and automatically know each visible aura's school or broad magical category. As an Action on a later turn, examine one aura to learn whether it is concentrated, summoned, cursed, warded or linked to another visible magical effect. Total cover blocks sight.

source.originalText: Arcane Sight: See magical auras and effects for a short duration.

card.name: Spell Preservation
card.effect: Spell Preservation. Tags: hero, spellbinder, passive, spellbook. Your primary spellbook cannot be destroyed, erased or rendered permanently unreadable by non-artifact mundane or magical means. It can still be stolen, hidden, transported, suppressed, sealed by an artifact-level effect or voluntarily abandoned. Copies and backup books do not automatically receive this protection.

source.originalText: Spell Preservation: Your spellbook cannot be destroyed by non-artifact means.

card.name: Knowledge Shield
card.rangeAndTarget: Allies directly protected by one of your Abjuration Wizard spells
card.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
card.frequency: At most once per ally per round
card.effect: Knowledge Shield. Tags: hero, spellbinder, passive, protection. When you cast an Abjuration spell that grants AC, temporary HP, resistance or a saving-throw benefit to an ally, that ally also gains +2 on its next saving throw before the start of your next regular turn. Multiple Knowledge Shields do not stack.

source.originalText: Knowledge Shield: When you cast a protective spell, allies gain +2 to saving throws.

card.name: Matrix Sharing
card.cost: 2 RP plus the shared spell's normal RP cost
card.duration: Until end of ally's next regular turn
card.effect: Matrix Sharing. Tags: hero, spellbinder, passive-upgrade, matrix. Choose one prepared Wizard spell of rank 3 or lower with an Action casting time. Pay both costs now. The ally may cast that spell once before the end of its next turn without paying RP, using your spell attack and DC. The shared spell cannot summon creatures, create additional Actions, use Overcast, be Shared again or bypass concentration limits. Granting this permission takes your Action; the ally spends its own normal Action to cast. The ally owns concentration and strain for the cast, and it does not update your matrix-family history or grant you cast-trigger resources.

source.originalText: Matrix Sharing: Grant an ally temporary access to one of your prepared spells.

card.name: Arcane Memory
card.cost: Normal RP cost of recalled spell
card.effect: Arcane Memory. Tags: hero, spellbinder, passive-upgrade, spellbook. Cast one legal-rank Wizard spell that you previously prepared and have recorded in your campaign memory log, even if it is not currently prepared or its spellbook entry is unavailable. Pay the normal RP cost and obey casting time, concentration and all ordinary restrictions. This grants no spell above your Wizard rank limit.

source.originalText: Arcane Memory: Recall and cast any spell you've ever prepared once per long rest.

card.name: Seal Magic
card.effect: Seal Magic. Tags: hero, spellbinder, wizard-spell, control. Choose one of the eight schools and target one creature. It makes a Wisdom save. On failure it cannot cast spells of the chosen school. At the end of each of its turns it repeats the save, ending the Seal on success. The effect ends automatically after 3 rounds and never prevents non-spell class techniques merely because they are magical.

source.originalText: Seal Magic: Prevent a target from casting spells of a specific school (WIS save, 3 rounds)

card.name: Ritual Casting
card.cost: 0 RP unless the individual ritual explicitly states otherwise
card.frequency: At will outside encounters with sufficient time
card.effect: Source progression line 5184. Cast a Wizard spell bearing the Ritual tag directly from your spellbook without preparing it. Increase its casting time by at least 10 minutes. Ritual Casting cannot be completed during an encounter, does not use an ordinary prepared-matrix position and does not generate or vent normal casting Dissonance.

source.originalText: | 2 | Counterspell Reaction, Ritual Casting |

card.name: School Mastery
card.effect: Source progression line 5186. This is the one School Mastery progression grant, not a second school choice or duplicate feat. Increase the level-1 Arcane School spell-attack and spell-save bonus from +1 to +2 total. Its school passive and bonus-spell rules otherwise remain unchanged.

source.originalText: | 5 | Bonus Feat: School Mastery |

card.name: Arcane Ward
card.effect: Source progression line 5187. After preparing spells, choose one of acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, necrotic, psychic, radiant or thunder that is dealt by at least one prepared spell of your Arcane School. Gain resistance to that damage type until your next long rest. If none of your prepared school spells deals a damage type, choose force. This is provisional completion of the source's ambiguous 'chosen school's element' wording.

source.originalText: | 6 | Arcane Ward (resistance to chosen school's element) |

card.name: Dual Cast
card.cost: Pay the complete RP costs of both spells
card.effect: Source progression line 5188. Choose two DIFFERENT prepared Wizard spells of rank 1 or 2, neither of which summons a creature or grants an additional Action. Cast both sequentially as one Action, paying both RP costs. They cannot both require concentration. Each matrix separately updates first-cast/Refrain history. Features that trigger merely from 'casting a spell' may trigger once for each actual matrix unless that feature itself says once per turn; no trigger may create another Dual Cast or additional full Action.

source.originalText: | 9 | Dual Cast (cast 2 Tier 1–2 spells in a round) |

card.name: Overchannel
card.cost: Pay the Core V 2 RP cost for one rank above the spell's normal cast rank
card.rangeAndTarget: One prepared spell you are beginning to cast
card.effect: Source progression line 5190. Cast one prepared spell as though it were one rank higher than the highest rank at which you could normally cast that SAME spell, provided the spell has an explicit higher-rank scaling rule. Overchannel does not teach or prepare a higher-rank spell, cannot exceed effective rank 9 and cannot be combined with another generic Overcast rule during this pilot. All normal Dissonance/Refrain rules still apply.

source.originalText: | 13 | Overchannel (cast a spell 1 tier higher once/day) |

card.name: Arcane Feedback
card.effect: Source progression line 5191, converted from historical slot wording to RP. After your Counterspell successfully negates a spell, restore 1 RP, never above your normal maximum. A counter produced by a companion, reflected spell or copied Counterspell does not trigger this feature.

source.originalText: | 15 | Arcane Feedback (after successfully countering a spell, recover 1 RP once per round) |

card.name: Tethered Cast
card.rangeAndTarget: One concentration Wizard spell you cast this turn that targets only yourself or one willing ally
card.frequency: At most once per round; only one Tethered Cast active at a time
card.effect: Source progression line 5192. After casting the qualifying spell, tether it. The tethered spell no longer occupies your one normal concentration slot for up to 3 rounds. When damage would require a concentration save for the tethered spell, make the save normally; failure ends only the tether. Starting another Tethered Cast ends the existing tether first. A Tethered Cast cannot itself tether Spell Tether's second spell or permit more than two simultaneously sustained Wizard effects.

source.originalText: | 17 | Tethered Cast (bonus action spell link 1/round) |

card.name: Spell Scribing
card.effect: Spell Scribing. Tags: base, passive, spellbook. Copying a legal found Wizard spell into your spellbook requires 1 hour and 25 gp of inks and components per spell rank, treating rank 0 as rank 1 for this calculation, instead of the pilot baseline 2 hours and 50 gp. Level-up spells remain free.

source.originalText: Spell Scribing: Copy spells into your spellbook at half the normal cost and time.

card.name: Arcane Insight
card.effect: Arcane Insight. Tags: base, passive, knowledge. Gain proficiency in Arcana, or expertise if already proficient. When examining an active magical effect, spell residue, magic item or arcane construction, you may make an Intelligence (Arcana) check to determine its broad school, function or unusual matrix behavior. The Director sets the normal knowledge DC; failure supplies no invented fact.

source.originalText: Arcane Insight: Identify magical effects and items with greater accuracy than non-wizards.

card.name: Matrix Efficiency
card.effect: Matrix Efficiency. Tags: base, passive, matrix. Your normal full daily Spell Matrix preparation time is reduced from 1 hour to 45 minutes. This does not reduce the separate 10-minute midday substitution ritual, spell scribing, rituals or spellbook reconstruction unless another feature explicitly says so.

source.originalText: Matrix Efficiency: Reduce the preparation time for spells by 25%.

card.name: Scholarly Mind
card.effect: Scholarly Mind. Tags: base, passive, knowledge. You have advantage on Intelligence checks whose primary purpose is recalling, researching or analyzing arcane theory, magical history, planar magical principles or constructed spell formulae. It does not grant advantage on spell attacks, Counterspell checks or general Investigation unrelated to arcane scholarship.

source.originalText: Scholarly Mind: Gain advantage on Intelligence checks related to arcane knowledge.

card.name: Arcane Bolt
card.effect: Arcane Bolt. Tags: base, active, wizard-spell, universal, damage. Make a Wizard spell attack. On a hit deal S d6 + M force damage. Arcane Bolt is an always-prepared class matrix once acquired and uses the normal first-distinct-matrix and Refrain rules.

source.originalText: Arcane Bolt: Launch a bolt of pure arcane energy that deals force damage to a single target.

card.name: Minor Conjuration
card.frequency: At will while RP remains; one object at a time
card.effect: Minor Conjuration. Tags: base, active, wizard-spell, conjuration. Create one nonmagical unattended object that fits inside a 1-foot cube, weighs no more than 10 pounds and is made of common nonvaluable material such as wood, cloth, clay, iron or glass. It cannot be food, poison, currency, a spell component with listed cost, ammunition with special properties or a functional complex mechanism. Creating another dismisses the first.

source.originalText: Minor Conjuration: Create a temporary, small inanimate object that lasts for 1 hour.

card.name: Arcane Shield
card.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
card.effect: Arcane Shield. Tags: base, active, wizard-spell, abjuration, protection. Trigger when an attack roll would hit you. Gain +2 AC against the triggering attack and until the start of your next regular turn, potentially causing the attack to miss. Temporary AC from another Arcane Shield does not stack.

source.originalText: Arcane Shield: Create a barrier of magical force that provides temporary protection.

card.name: Analyze Magic
card.rangeAndTarget: One magical creature, object or effect within 30 feet
card.effect: Analyze Magic. Tags: base, active, wizard-spell, divination, knowledge. Make an Intelligence (Arcana) check against DC 10 + the effect's spell rank, treating a non-spell effect's Director-assigned tier as rank. On success learn its school or magical category, one active mechanical property and whether it is currently sustained, cursed or bound to another effect. Failure reveals only that magic is present.

source.originalText: Analyze Magic: Study a magical effect or item to gain insight into its properties and function.

card.name: Spellbook Study
card.effect: Spellbook Study. Tags: base, active, matrix, ritual. Replace one currently prepared matrix with one legal spell recorded in your spellbook. The replacement must be within your Wizard rank limit. This is the normal midday substitution permission; it does not alter the spellbook, create another prepared-matrix position or reset first-cast/Refrain history for an underlying matrix family already cast this encounter.

source.originalText: Spellbook Study: Spend time studying your spellbook to prepare a different selection of spells.

card.name: Floating Preparation
card.effect: Floating Preparation. Tags: arch, passive, matrix. Increase your maximum prepared Spell Matrix count by 1. The extra matrix can come from any school and obeys all ordinary spellbook and rank restrictions. It is a prepared matrix for every rule, including protected strain, duplicate-family tracking and Matrix Mastery modifications.

source.originalText: Floating Preparation: Prepare 1 extra spell from any school each day

card.name: Sigil Rewrite
card.effect: Sigil Rewrite. Tags: arch, passive-upgrade, matrix. Replace one prepared matrix with a different spell from your spellbook of exactly the same rank without performing the normal 10-minute ritual. The replacement receives no special Dissonance reset for a matrix family already used this encounter and must obey current Wizard rank eligibility.

source.originalText: Sigil Rewrite: Once/day, instantly swap a spell you know for another of the same tier

card.name: Spell Tether
card.effect: Spell Tether. Tags: arch, passive-upgrade, concentration, tether. When you begin a second concentration spell that targets only yourself while already concentrating on a self-only spell, spend 3 additional RP. For up to 3 rounds you may maintain both. Whenever damage requires a concentration save, make one save; failure ends BOTH spells. Starting a third concentration effect ends both tethered spells before the new one begins. Spell Tether and Tethered Cast cannot be combined; maximum two sustained concentration effects total. Only one Spell Tether can exist at a time.

source.originalText: Spell Tether: Maintain 2 self-buff spells without concentration (1/rest)

card.name: Matrix Mastery
card.effect: Matrix Mastery. Tags: arch, passive, matrix. During preparation you may assign at most one common Matrix Mastery modification to each ordinary prepared spell: Quick Substitution, Component Enhancement, Matrix Linking or Stability Reinforcement, using the exact common definitions in the Wizard engine. Always-prepared class-card matrices cannot receive these modifications unless a card explicitly says otherwise.

source.originalText: Matrix Mastery: Modify spell matrices to change minor aspects of prepared spells.

card.name: Arcane Tradition
card.frequency: Automatic at Wizard 3; not a selection
card.effect: Arcane Tradition. Tags: arch, school, automatic. Your level-1 Arcane School becomes your Arcanist tradition; do not choose a second school. Prepare one additional matrix from that same school each day without counting it against your normal prepared-matrix maximum. It otherwise obeys all ordinary rank, spellbook, Dissonance and duplicate-family rules.

source.originalText: Arcane Tradition: Choose a school of magic to specialize in, gaining bonuses to spells of that school.

card.name: Improved Concentration
card.effect: Improved Concentration. Tags: arch, passive, concentration. You have advantage on Constitution saving throws made because damage threatens your concentration on a Wizard spell. This does not alter the DC, protect a Tether from rules that explicitly end both effects, or prevent Silence, incapacitation and other non-damage concentration failures.

source.originalText: Improved Concentration: Advantage on concentration checks when taking damage.

card.name: Counterspell
card.rangeAndTarget: One creature you perceive casting a spell within 60 feet
card.effect: Counterspell. Tags: arch-source, automatic, wizard-spell, abjuration, disruption. Trigger when a creature begins casting a spell. Make an Intelligence check adding proficiency against DC 10 + twice the spell's rank, treating rank 0 as 0. Success negates the triggering spell after its costs are paid; failure lets it resolve. This is gained automatically at Wizard 2 and is never also selected from the Arch pool.

source.originalText: Counterspell: Disrupt an enemy's spellcasting, potentially negating their spell entirely.

card.name: Arcane Lock
card.rangeAndTarget: One door, chest, portal or unattended object within touch
card.effect: Arcane Lock. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, abjuration. Magically seal the target. Opening it without your permission requires a Strength check or thieves'/arcane-tool check against your Wizard spell DC. Dispel Magic can end the lock. You can designate up to M creatures who can bypass it. This does not make the object physically indestructible.

source.originalText: Arcane Lock: Create a magical barrier that prevents entry or access to an object or area.

card.name: Dispel Magic
card.rangeAndTarget: One creature, object or magical effect within 60 feet
card.effect: Dispel Magic. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, abjuration. Choose one ongoing spell effect you can perceive. If its rank is 3 or lower, end it. If it is rank 4 or higher, make an Intelligence check adding proficiency against DC 10 + spell rank; success ends it. Permanent artifact properties and effects explicitly immune to dispelling are unaffected.

source.originalText: Dispel Magic: End magical effects in an area or on a target.

card.name: Dimensional Pocket
card.effect: Dimensional Pocket. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, conjuration, ritual. Create an extradimensional storage space holding up to 100 pounds or 10 cubic feet of unattended nonliving material. Retrieving or placing an item while adjacent to the opening uses an object interaction. Living creatures cannot enter. When duration ends, remaining contents appear harmlessly in the nearest unoccupied space.

source.originalText: Dimensional Pocket: Create a small extradimensional space to store items.

card.name: Arcane Sight
card.effect: Arcane Sight. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, divination, concentration. While active you perceive magical auras within 60 feet and automatically know each visible aura's school or broad magical category. As an Action on a later turn, examine one aura to learn whether it is concentrated, summoned, cursed, warded or linked to another visible magical effect. Total cover blocks sight.

source.originalText: Arcane Sight: See magical auras and effects for a short duration.

card.name: Spell Preservation
card.effect: Spell Preservation. Tags: hero, spellbinder, passive, spellbook. Your primary spellbook cannot be destroyed, erased or rendered permanently unreadable by non-artifact mundane or magical means. It can still be stolen, hidden, transported, suppressed, sealed by an artifact-level effect or voluntarily abandoned. Copies and backup books do not automatically receive this protection.

source.originalText: Spell Preservation: Your spellbook cannot be destroyed by non-artifact means.

card.name: Knowledge Shield
card.rangeAndTarget: Allies directly protected by one of your Abjuration Wizard spells
card.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
card.frequency: At most once per ally per round
card.effect: Knowledge Shield. Tags: hero, spellbinder, passive, protection. When you cast an Abjuration spell that grants AC, temporary HP, resistance or a saving-throw benefit to an ally, that ally also gains +2 on its next saving throw before the start of your next regular turn. Multiple Knowledge Shields do not stack.

source.originalText: Knowledge Shield: When you cast a protective spell, allies gain +2 to saving throws.

card.name: Matrix Sharing
card.cost: 2 RP plus the shared spell's normal RP cost
card.duration: Until end of ally's next regular turn
card.effect: Matrix Sharing. Tags: hero, spellbinder, passive-upgrade, matrix. Choose one prepared Wizard spell of rank 3 or lower with an Action casting time. Pay both costs now. The ally may cast that spell once before the end of its next turn without paying RP, using your spell attack and DC. The shared spell cannot summon creatures, create additional Actions, use Overcast, be Shared again or bypass concentration limits. Granting this permission takes your Action; the ally spends its own normal Action to cast. The ally owns concentration and strain for the cast, and it does not update your matrix-family history or grant you cast-trigger resources.

source.originalText: Matrix Sharing: Grant an ally temporary access to one of your prepared spells.

card.name: Arcane Memory
card.cost: Normal RP cost of recalled spell
card.effect: Arcane Memory. Tags: hero, spellbinder, passive-upgrade, spellbook. Cast one legal-rank Wizard spell that you previously prepared and have recorded in your campaign memory log, even if it is not currently prepared or its spellbook entry is unavailable. Pay the normal RP cost and obey casting time, concentration and all ordinary restrictions. This grants no spell above your Wizard rank limit.

source.originalText: Arcane Memory: Recall and cast any spell you've ever prepared once per long rest.

card.name: Seal Magic
card.effect: Seal Magic. Tags: hero, spellbinder, wizard-spell, control. Choose one of the eight schools and target one creature. It makes a Wisdom save. On failure it cannot cast spells of the chosen school. At the end of each of its turns it repeats the save, ending the Seal on success. The effect ends automatically after 3 rounds and never prevents non-spell class techniques merely because they are magical.

source.originalText: Seal Magic: Prevent a target from casting spells of a specific school (WIS save, 3 rounds)

card.name: Ritual Casting
card.cost: 0 RP unless the individual ritual explicitly states otherwise
card.frequency: At will outside encounters with sufficient time
card.effect: Source progression line 5184. Cast a Wizard spell bearing the Ritual tag directly from your spellbook without preparing it. Increase its casting time by at least 10 minutes. Ritual Casting cannot be completed during an encounter, does not use an ordinary prepared-matrix position and does not generate or vent normal casting Dissonance.

source.originalText: | 2 | Counterspell Reaction, Ritual Casting |

card.name: School Mastery
card.effect: Source progression line 5186. This is the one School Mastery progression grant, not a second school choice or duplicate feat. Increase the level-1 Arcane School spell-attack and spell-save bonus from +1 to +2 total. Its school passive and bonus-spell rules otherwise remain unchanged.

source.originalText: | 5 | Bonus Feat: School Mastery |

card.name: Arcane Ward
card.effect: Source progression line 5187. After preparing spells, choose one of acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, necrotic, psychic, radiant or thunder that is dealt by at least one prepared spell of your Arcane School. Gain resistance to that damage type until your next long rest. If none of your prepared school spells deals a damage type, choose force. This is provisional completion of the source's ambiguous 'chosen school's element' wording.

source.originalText: | 6 | Arcane Ward (resistance to chosen school's element) |

card.name: Dual Cast
card.cost: Pay the complete RP costs of both spells
card.effect: Source progression line 5188. Choose two DIFFERENT prepared Wizard spells of rank 1 or 2, neither of which summons a creature or grants an additional Action. Cast both sequentially as one Action, paying both RP costs. They cannot both require concentration. Each matrix separately updates first-cast/Refrain history. Features that trigger merely from 'casting a spell' may trigger once for each actual matrix unless that feature itself says once per turn; no trigger may create another Dual Cast or additional full Action.

source.originalText: | 9 | Dual Cast (cast 2 Tier 1–2 spells in a round) |

card.name: Overchannel
card.cost: Pay the Core V 2 RP cost for one rank above the spell's normal cast rank
card.rangeAndTarget: One prepared spell you are beginning to cast
card.effect: Source progression line 5190. Cast one prepared spell as though it were one rank higher than the highest rank at which you could normally cast that SAME spell, provided the spell has an explicit higher-rank scaling rule. Overchannel does not teach or prepare a higher-rank spell, cannot exceed effective rank 9 and cannot be combined with another generic Overcast rule during this pilot. All normal Dissonance/Refrain rules still apply.

source.originalText: | 13 | Overchannel (cast a spell 1 tier higher once/day) |

card.name: Arcane Feedback
card.effect: Source progression line 5191, converted from historical slot wording to RP. After your Counterspell successfully negates a spell, restore 1 RP, never above your normal maximum. A counter produced by a companion, reflected spell or copied Counterspell does not trigger this feature.

source.originalText: | 15 | Arcane Feedback (after successfully countering a spell, recover 1 RP once per round) |

card.name: Tethered Cast
card.rangeAndTarget: One concentration Wizard spell you cast this turn that targets only yourself or one willing ally
card.frequency: At most once per round; only one Tethered Cast active at a time
card.effect: Source progression line 5192. After casting the qualifying spell, tether it. The tethered spell no longer occupies your one normal concentration slot for up to 3 rounds. When damage would require a concentration save for the tethered spell, make the save normally; failure ends only the tether. Starting another Tethered Cast ends the existing tether first. A Tethered Cast cannot itself tether Spell Tether's second spell or permit more than two simultaneously sustained Wizard effects.

source.originalText: | 17 | Tethered Cast (bonus action spell link 1/round) |
